title: Singapore Savings Bonds: rates and results
description: Every Singapore Savings Bond since the first in October 2015: its interest year by year, the average return if you cash it in after each year, the amount offered and applied for, and, when it was oversubscribed, how much each applicant got.
question: What does each Singapore Savings Bond pay, and how was it allotted?

row.is: One Savings Bond issue (one month's bond)
